title: LivingRoom Move: Gentle Chair & Home Movement
shortDescription: Gentle movement for your living room. Explore seated and beginner routines with clear captions, readable text and simple Fire TV remote controls. Reviewed sessions are required before release.
longDescription:
LivingRoom Move is being built for people who prefer a gentle, comfortable start to movement at home. Choose proposed 5, 10 or 15 minute sessions, explore chair-supported movement, mobility and beginner balance, and save favourites on your television.

Free starter sessions will work without a phone, wearable or custom account. Large text, clear focus indicators, captions and straightforward remote controls help you move at your own pace. Family setup allows a trusted person to help with settings only with your permission; it provides no remote monitoring.

Optional four-week programmes and subscription offers are planned. Amazon purchasing, licensed instructional footage, human narration and qualified professional review must be completed before these are offered.

This engineering preview contains planning placeholders and does not provide finished exercise lessons. It makes no medical or rehabilitation claims. Progress and preferences stay on this device, and there are no advertisements.

Do not submit this draft as a finished-product listing. Rewrite its future-tense and preview statements only after the corresponding release gates have passed.
featureBullets: Designed for straightforward Fire TV remote navigation
Large adjustable text and visible focus controls
Local favourites and preferences without a custom account
Consent-based family setup and simple data deletion
